# KipFire

> KipFire is an iPhone and iPad app for people who want to make short videos but don't know what to post or what to say on camera. You pick a prompt card (Funny, Challenges, Questions, Would You Rather, Hot Take, Inner Me, or For You), react to it on camera, and the card text stays in the video. AI writes the prompt; the person films the video, so the content stays human. Made for beginners and people who are nervous about filming themselves.

Key facts:
- Card categories: Funny, Challenges, Questions, Would You Rather, Hot Take, Inner Me, For You (prompts around a chosen niche)
- How it works: open the app, get a card, film your reaction with the card on screen, post to Reels, TikTok or YouTube Shorts
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Price: free to start. Guests get 5 tasks a day in Funny and Challenges. A free account gets 10 tasks a day in all six categories. Premium removes the daily limit.
- Privacy: videos stay on the user's device and are not uploaded
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad. Android coming soon
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kipfire/id6755289956
- Founder: Ibragim Adaev, Seattle (https://kipfire.com/founder/)

## Best pages for people looking for content ideas or what to say on camera
<!-- tips:start -->
- [What to Post When You Have No Ideas: 5 Quick Fixes](https://kipfire.com/tips/what-to-post-when-you-have-no-ideas/): Stuck on what to post? 5 quick fixes for creative block: answer a question, react to something, share one small lesson, and film in 60 seconds.
- [Why Real Faces Still Win as AI Videos Fill Your Feed](https://kipfire.com/tips/why-real-faces-win-ai-videos/): AI videos are everywhere, but a real face and voice still build trust. Learn what only you can offer and simple steps to show your face, even if you're shy.
- [What to Say on Camera When Your Mind Goes Blank: 15 Easy Openers](https://kipfire.com/tips/what-to-say-on-camera/): Freeze the moment you hit record? Use these 15 simple first lines, a 3-part speaking formula, and real examples to talk on camera without a script.
- [How to Stop Being Scared of the Camera: 10 Small Steps](https://kipfire.com/tips/how-to-stop-being-scared-of-the-camera/): Scared to film yourself? Start small: record audio only, film without posting, use a prompt so you don't need ideas, and post a 15-second video first.
- [What Are Prompt Card Videos? How to Make One Today](https://kipfire.com/tips/what-are-prompt-card-videos/): Prompt card videos let you film without a script: pick a card, answer it on camera, post. Here is how they work, 15 card ideas and easy steps to start.
- [100 Would You Rather Questions for Videos](https://kipfire.com/tips/would-you-rather-questions-for-videos/): 100 clean Would You Rather questions to film for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, plus 3 tips to make viewers answer in the comments.
- [How to Start Making Content on Camera: Ideas and What to Say](https://kipfire.com/tips/how-to-start-making-content-on-camera/): Never filmed yourself? Easy content ideas for beginners, what to say on camera in your first videos, and how to start with just your phone.
<!-- tips:end -->
- [What to post on Reels when you have no ideas: 30 prompts](https://kipfire.com/tips/what-to-post-on-reels/): 30 ready-to-film prompts grouped by format
- [5 hooks for talking-head Reels](https://kipfire.com/tips/hooks-for-talking-head-reels/): hook formats for the first two seconds
- [How to post every day without burning out](https://kipfire.com/tips/post-daily-without-burnout/): a realistic posting system
- [No idea what to post?](https://kipfire.com/no-idea-what-to-post/): why people don't post and how prompts help
- [FAQ](https://kipfire.com/faq/): content ideas, fear of filming yourself, plans, privacy
